title: Industrial kit: synthesized mechanical hits, riddim and feels
description: Industrial EDM as data: synthesized (CC0) circuit-breaker clangs, metal impacts, anvil, pipe, relays, ratchet, chain, shatter, hydraulic hiss, servo whine, slams, stamp press, rust and factory beds; an industrial kit, native riddim / growl / clank basses, hit grammars, a 64-bar form as gates and four feel templates, generated by tools/concepts/build.mjs.

ingredients.title: Industrial atoms
ingredients.description: glyphcore/industrial atoms (ind.): half-time, four-floor and noise kick patterns, chain / relay / ratchet patterns, hit grammars by density (hits1, hits2, hits4, hits7, hitsGap), riddim / growl / clank / sub / rumble lines, the 64-bar form as gates and masks.

ingredients.title: Feel: Industrial riddim
ingredients.description: Feel template "Industrial riddim" (140-150 bpm): half-time stamp kick and clang snare, chain 16ths. Slots drums (kick, snare, perc), top (hats, top), bass, harmony, fx, groove; per voice <v> (pattern), <v>Vel (accents), <v>Rack (rack | groove).

ingredients.title: Feel: Industrial half-time
